events.note: Caelundas sets an inner planet when its ecliptic longitude gap to the Sun closes through 6°. Horizons: Venus 4.96°, Sun 358.96°, so Venus is east of the Sun across 0° Aries and the set is an evening set; the gap reaches 6° at 07:59 UT

name: Venus closes on the Sun from the east across 0° Aries on 19 March 2025
